business_problem: China Unicom needed to cut the cost of serving customers across hotline and online channels, break down siloed service systems, and modernize aging provincial deployments without compromising support quality for a very large subscriber base.
solution_summary: China Unicom adopted Baidu AI Cloud's ABC smart customer-service solution to unify the 10010 hotline, internet service channels, and the broader intelligent-customer-service operating model behind one centralized platform. Keyue Intelligent Customer Service Enterprise Edition delivers the customer-facing service layer, while the Keyue voice engine handles high-accuracy speech recognition and semantic interpretation. Responses are grounded in a structured enterprise knowledge graph, and a supporting AI operations platform lets China Unicom train models, configure flows, test, publish, analyze, and optimize services without rebuilding the stack each time. The deployment also uses a container-based microservice architecture so capacity can scale elastically under high concurrency. Together, those layers give China Unicom a practical way to replace fragmented channel tools with a shared AI foundation that supports nationwide rollout and lower-cost long-term operations.
products_used: Keyue Intelligent Customer Service Enterprise Edition
Keyue Intelligent Customer Service Voice Engine

solution_components.name: Keyue Intelligent Customer Service Enterprise Edition
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized customer-service application layer across hotline and online channels.

solution_components.name: Keyue Intelligent Customer Service Voice Engine
solution_components.role: Performs the speech recognition and semantic understanding that drives automated voice interactions.

solution_components.name: Enterprise Knowledge Graph
solution_components.role: Supplies the structured knowledge base used to ground answers and service logic.

solution_components.name: AI Operations Platform
solution_components.role: Lets teams train models, configure workflows, test, release, and optimize customer-service capabilities continuously.

data_flow: Requests from the 10010 hotline and online service channels enter the Keyue platform, where the voice engine converts speech and interprets semantics. The dialogue layer then queries the enterprise knowledge graph, returns answers or routing actions to each channel, and sends performance feedback into the AI operations platform for retraining, flow updates, and release management.
business_outcome: China Unicom gained a centralized intelligent customer-service stack that improves cross-channel consistency, supports lower-cost autonomous operations, and provides a scalable foundation for wider national rollout and service upgrades.
metrics: China Unicom's user base exceeded 400 million as of November 2018.
architecture_clues: The platform combines speech and semantic recognition with natural multi-turn dialogue.
A structured enterprise knowledge graph grounds answers across channels.
Operations teams can train models, configure processes, test, publish, analyze, and optimize in one platform.
The deployment uses a container-based microservice architecture for elastic scaling under high concurrency.
evidence_quotes: China Unicom used Baidu AI technology and the ABC smart customer service solution to optimize the basic service capabilities of the 10010 hotline and internet online channels (original: 借助百度人工智能技术、ABC 智能客服产品整体解决方案，中国联通优化了10010热线、互联网在线等不同渠道的基础服务能力).

The pain points included high channel-operating costs, isolated systems, lack of shared underlying capabilities, and old provincial hardware and software versions (original: 客服场景服务渠道及触点运营成本高，各渠道系统孤立建设、底层能力不共享、省份软硬件版本老旧等痛点).

The solution uses high-accuracy speech and semantic recognition, natural multi-turn dialogue, and a structured enterprise knowledge graph (original: 通过高准确的语音、语义识别技术、自然的多轮对话交互能力，依托结构化的企业知识图谱为用户提供智能贴心服务).

It also provides an integrated platform for model training, process configuration, testing, release, analysis, and optimization, and runs on a container-based microservice architecture with elastic scaling (original: 提供可由企业自主模型训练、流程配置、测试发布、分析优化的一体化流程持续运营平台；基于容器的微服务架构，在高并发场景下可弹性伸缩).
As of November 2018, China Unicom served more than 400 million users (original: 截至2018年11月联通用户量超4亿户).
